title: Nine Years of Running
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：charity　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 charity 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 my mother was sent to run ① charity she could not fund, and she said the running was the whole of the lesson. The ② charity, meaning the organisation and not the giving, was nine years old and was run by whoever came last; charity, she said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ charity in that town had the same box, and the ④ charity at the end, meaning the one the vicar kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever ran properly. Charity, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ charity was the whole of the winter, meaning the kindness it carried and not the organisation. The ⑥ charity, meaning the kindness and not any of that, is the only thing in a winter that everybody needs and nobody questions; charity, he said, is either something you run or the only word that means both an organisation and a kindness. She said the kindness is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ charity had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the box. The ⑧ charity of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine years and eleven years of running; charity, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ charity I remember is the one at the end, which was run in 1972 and is still described as the poorest in the county. A ⑩ charity, my grandmother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being run; every charity, she said, is a kindness that has agreed to look like an organisation. She said the kindness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 慈善机构；慈善事业
B. n. 慈善机构（指那个组织本身，与那份给予相对）
C. 固定搭配：run a charity 经营一家慈善机构
D. n. 慈善机构（指镇上每一家）
E. n. 慈善机构（指末尾那一家）
F. n. 仁爱（抽象：它承载的那份善心）
G. n. 那份善心（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The charity, meaning the organisation and not the giving
charity was the whole of the winter
the charity had become a number in a report
The charity of the whole thing
A charity, my grandmother said in 1977

answers.why: run a charity 意为“经营一家慈善机构”，1952 年母亲被派去经营她资助不起的那家慈善机构。
charity 意为“慈善机构、慈善事业”，指那个组织本身而不是那份给予，办了九年，由最后来的人经营。
charity 指镇上每一家慈善机构，每一家都是同样的募捐箱。
charity 指末尾那一家（牧师保留的那一家），是唯一有人认真经营过的。
charity 意为“仁爱”，抽象指它承载的那份善心，父亲说 charity 就是那个冬天的全部。
charity 为抽象用法，指那份善心本身，是一个冬天里人人都需要、却没人质疑的东西。
charity 意为“慈善机构、慈善事业”，到 1967 年这家 charity 成了报告里的一个数字。
charity 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年与十一年的经营。
charity 意为“慈善机构”，我记得的是末尾那一家，1972 年经营，至今仍被说成全县最穷的。
charity 为抽象总称，祖母说一家慈善机构是唯一会因为被认真经营而变好的东西。
